source: NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily, station USC00253825 (HICKMAN, Nebraska) PRCP; Byun and Wilhite (1999) Table 5 transcribed from the AMS table image
subset_description: hickman_prcp_1960_1996.csv: daily PRCP in mm for 1960-01-01 through 1996-12-31 (13515 days); 68 days (0.5%) missing or quality-flagged were filled with the station's mean for the same calendar day (flag column). table5.csv: the dry/drought-duration and minimum APD/PRN/EDI rows of Table 5 for Eq. (2) and Eq. (3); the 'Minimum of CNS' row is excluded because it is inconsistent with the paper's own CNS definition (#1135). Table 5 is at https://journals.ametsoc.org/view/journals/clim/12/9/full-i1520-0442-12-9-2747-t05.gif (read 2026-11-23, values match the oracle survey transcription). Paper days count from 1 January 1995 (day 1) to 31 December 1996 (day 731).
citation: Byun, H.-R. and Wilhite, D. A. (1999) Objective quantification of drought severity and duration. Journal of Climate 12(9):2747-2756; Menne, M. J., Durre, I., Vose, R. S., Gleason, B. E. and Houston, T. G. (2012) An overview of the Global Historical Climatology Network-Daily database. Journal of Atmospheric and Oceanic Technology 29(7):897-910.
license: GHCN-Daily: public domain (U.S. Government work, 17 USC 105). Table 5 numbers are facts transcribed from an AMS-copyrighted table; only the ten values are reproduced, not the table image.
notes: CHARACTERIZATION, not exact-reference validation. Departures from the paper that make exact agreement impossible: (1) the library implements the fixed 365-day Eq. (2) window (ADR-0014 decision 1), the paper uses a variable summation duration DS that grows through dry spells; (2) the paper's record is a 113-station High Plains subset with nearest-station-within-100-km substitution, here only the calendar-day-mean fallback is applied to a single station (USC00253825, a candidate identified in #1135, not confirmed as the paper's station); (3) the library's MEP/SD baseline is the 1961-1990 calibration window with no five-day smoothing, the paper's 30-year window within 1960-1996 is unspecified; (4) Table 5 reports one-decimal summary rows, not a daily EDI series. The test asserts two criteria declared before the library was run on this record: the library EDI is at or below -1 on the paper's minimum-EDI day 469, and the library's 1995-1996 EDI minimum falls inside the paper's Eq. (2) drought duration (days 259-493). The measured_stats are recorded for audit and are not asserted. The library minimum (-2.10) is shallower than the paper's -2.5 and falls on day 438 rather than 469, consistent with the fixed window omitting the variable-DS extension; no tolerance is claimed on those values.
